title: De Lima calls for probe into arrest of over 300 Asean protesters

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Mamamayang Liberal Party-list Rep. Leila de Lima on Monday called for an investigation into the arrest of over 300 protesters amid the commencement of the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit and Related Summits, emphasizing that the government should respect their rights to express themselves. This came after the police arrested over 300 protesters in Manila and Muntinlupa on Sunday as they were preparing to march to the Philippine International Convention Center in Pasay City, where the main event of the summit is being held.
